messages:
maria: Hey — quick FYI, today's infra-sync calendar invite sent a different Zoom link to most attendees. People in APAC couldn't join the old link. I think the recurring series got split when someone edited an instance. Anyone else seeing duplicate/new links?
kevin: Yep I saw that. Google Calendar + Zoom integration sometimes creates a new meeting link when you edit a single occurrence. If you edit the series it should keep one link, but if the integration is set to one-off meetings it will regenerate.
sam: I accidentally edited one occurrence yesterday (added agenda) and calendar popped a new URL. Sorry about that. We should either recreate a single-series invite with a fixed meeting link or use a team meeting (non-PMI) and set "Use same meeting for all events" in Zoom.
lia: Also a scheduling note: rotating the sync time would help APAC folks — maybe we alternate weeks? If we change the series we'll need to re-run a quick availability poll.
maria: Agreed on poll. Can someone recreate the recurring event with a consistent Zoom link and paste the meeting ID/pass? I'm trying to avoid PMI usage for security reasons. Proposed agenda for the next 3 weeks (copy for new invite):
```
Infra sync (30m)
1) Rollouts & deploy health (5m)
2) RFC reviews (10m) — @sam to present rfc/inference-routing
3) Triage / blocking issues (10m)
4) Ops notes & follow-ups (5m)
```
sam: I can create the new series. Plan: create a dedicated team Zoom meeting (not PMI), enable "use same meeting link", add RSVP/description, and paste the meeting ID + passcode in the description. Will also set a calendar note: "If you see a different Zoom link please DM me instead of joining the other one."
calendar-bot: Event updated by kevin — "Infra sync" (recurring) — link changed.
kevin: Quick ops note: if you edit the calendar using the Google web UI it tends to keep the series link if you choose "Edit series"; editing a single occurrence -> splits. Also double-check the Zoom Marketplace app settings for "One-click scheduling" options.
jamie: Should we avoid PMI entirely? Security team prefers rotating links unless it's a protected internal channel. For a 30m infra sync I think a team meeting with unique credentials is fine. :thumbsup:
maria: OK decision: sam will recreate the recurring series with a single consistent team Zoom link (non-PMI), lia will run a 1-question Doodle/When2Meet for rotating time preference, kevin will verify Zoom integration settings, and I'll update the invite description with the agenda and meeting ID.
sam: Creating event now. I'll post the new event link + meeting ID in this thread once done.
lia: I'll spin up a 3-option poll (Tue 08:00 UTC / Tue 16:00 UTC / Wed 00:00 UTC) and drop results by EOD.
kevin: I'll also flag infra calendar settings in the admin console so it shouldn't auto-split again.
maria: Thanks everyone. If you get a duplicate invite please decline and accept the new series once posted. :pray:
sam: New series created and invites sent. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 — passcode in event description. Let me know if anyone can't access it.
jamie: Got it and joined. All good from my side.
maria: Closing loop — agenda is in the invite, poll results will determine rotating schedule next week. Cheers.
